- I have no adb/shell access in this environment (no `am start -W`, no `logcat`, no way to read `ActivityManager`'s reported `TotalTime`/`WaitTime`), and no system clock tool.

- Even a screenshot taken immediately after `mobile_launch_app` returns already shows the fully-rendered BenchTarget home screen (Catalog/Form/About/Checkout) — meaning the app renders faster than the round-trip time of a single tool call.
